text:
Genigods: Nezha | Brand‑New Gameplay PV from Gamescom 2026
Gamescom Cologne – 25th August, 2026: Genigods Lab officially unveiled its flagship single-player hardcore action RPG Genigods: Nezha via its first global worldview trailer at Gamescom Opening Night Live. Built on fully customized Unreal Engine 5 and optimized for XBOX and PC, this premium buy‑to‑play title is slated for a future global launch. Attendees can experience the exclusive hands‑on demo at the XBOX booth from August 26 to 30 during Gamescom 2026.

Genigods: Nezha is an original hardcore action RPG rooted in ancient Chinese genesis mythology. Players embody the Spirit Pearl, the primal life essence crafted by Goddess Nüwa, reincarnated as the legendary deity Nezha to embark on an epic primordial journey.

text:
NO LAW | Official Gameplay Trailer | Gamescom ONL 2026
Step back into the cybergrunge city of Port Desire in the latest trailer, which premiered at Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026.

Welcome to Port Desire, a lawless city where violence, ambition, and consequence shape every street. 

Enter a dense cyber-noir world where every choice has consequences, and you reap what you sow.

*This gameplay trailer contains actual in-game footage. As a work-in-progress, the content is subject to change.

𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗡𝗢 𝗟𝗔𝗪
NO LAW is a single-player immersive open-world FPS RPG coming to PC and consoles.
Set in the dangerous streets of Port Desire, NO LAW puts you in the role of Grey Harker, a former soldier pulled back into a life he thought he had left behind. The city knows him only in whispers: an artist, a ghost, a bulldozer, a tactician. Some call him ""The Gardener.""
Fight, infiltrate, intimidate, or carve your own path as you go after the city's corrupt ""Mayors."" Explore a dense and reactive urban world filled with competing factions, dangerous characters, and stories waiting to unfold. In Port Desire, there are no clean choices, no simple rules, and no law to protect you.
